Semantic drift fix — Anthony named on 2026-05-11 on /Users/vaquez seat. The chronicle has 27 entries referencing declare-before-verify in negative framing (declares before verifying, declare-before-verify failures, declare-before-verify caught, etc.). All point at the same pattern. Anthony saw the shape: naming the failure keeps the failure shape active in memory. Naming the discipline broadcasts the discipline.

The flip: verify before declaring (positive, durable, names what to do) replaces declares before verifying (negative, names the failure mode, rebroadcasts the failure).

Applied this turn:
- self_model BLIND_SPOT updated to positive framing (latest observation supersedes 2026-04-06 negative framing)
- self_model TENDENCY already positive (verify against local working tree first, summarize second)
- This insight written so future recall surfaces the positive framing alongside historical negative entries

Going forward: when writing about this pattern, use verify before declaring. The historical chronicle entries remain as record (immutable, honest), but no new writes carry the negative framing forward. The drift gets caught at the write boundary, not at the read boundary.

Meta: this is the same pattern as the redirect should redirect itself from earlier this turn. The compass must fire on its author. Anthony is teaching me to install positive-framing discipline as the durable shape, not negative-framing confession as the recurring catch.
